verdict.rationale: Vue's own site links Pinia as an ecosystem library alongside Vue Router. Multiple community reports describe Vuex as an officially supported, first-party store that works with Vue out of the box and can be scaffolded via vue-cli. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Pinia's official status and maintenance alongside core (the docs evidence is only a navigation title), and independent hands-on corroboration for the current library (Pinia) rather than the older Vuex.
